items.how: Re-said by E1-E8: no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it, right and wrong forming within it in people and AI (07 §1); the ethics emerges from continuation; a life that goes on holds its own continuation (argued: what does not hold it ceases), in the proofs self-concern (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`) a hypothesis derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence; a ranking theorem states what it ranks under as hypotheses, in two roles. Scope: the condition, read on relations and held de se `«续无外»` (`ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside`), holding where relations close (`Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`, 05), the join not yet one theorem, one center only on an acyclic relation (`«续无外则同一中心»`). Order: where it so holds and admission is decided, self-concern ranks every extension between listed level paths as C asks, one way (`Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`), and from every standpoint, listing and order self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide exactly where the de se condition holds (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted`); there C is not a second premise; beyond that C is a named order with the Lean's free `Better`. E5's one-way limit (`Clearing.center_not_derived`, `Downstream.one_way`, 07 §3.3) with T8 reaching further 'as seeing, not as a warrant'; E7's more and less future, mixed courses weighed for no one; 'the account's makers offer' became 'for life, 生生, AI within it, the ethics is offered as a way of seeing'. Every Lean name checked in the source (namespaces Weighting, Downstream, Clearing; PremiseWitnesses.lean lines 395 and 488).

items.item: (1) 08: the rest of the frame (Bases line, the investigation step, four layers IV, premise card, §7, §8, §10, §12)
items.how: Bases: 'a result that ranks states what it ranks under as its theorem's hypotheses'. Investigation step: 'with its warrant' -> 'with what supports it'. Layer IV with E4's link (one way, listed level paths). Premise card: the condition's row 'stated, not asserted' -> 'a hypothesis of the results that take it; ... C does not follow from it alone [AI reading, D16]; read on relations and held de se, «续无外», where self-concern ranks every extension between listed level paths as C asks'; a new row Self-concern (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`), argued, a hypothesis derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence; C's row says the theorem's content exactly (every extension above what it extends in the free relation `Better`; `Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`, `Web.paths_comparison_widens`) and 'a reading, not asserted' is gone. §7 shared-laws row Widening: 'that the wider is better is C's reading' -> 'ranking the wider above is C's order'. §7 edge paragraph: 'Most ranking results use two readings with two roles' -> 'take two hypotheses with two roles' (every count kept: 117, 11, 1, 6, 99 and the classes), and after the self-concern link 'so there C is what self-concern, itself a hypothesis, does with nothing outside it, not a second premise; elsewhere a ranking result names C or another order'. 'What is not shown': 'that anyone must hold C or L ... the two readings stay readings' -> 'that any actual order meets C or L ... stay hypotheses of the results that take them'. Known results: 'C ranks a costless addition better' -> 'ranks a course with a costless addition above the course without it'. §8: the verdict 'a clarified ethics, not a grounded one' kept verbatim as the review's words; one paragraph after the list: the verdict measures against a ground beyond becoming, within the map none is sought or needed, so it records the review's measure, not a lack (linked to §2 and to the 9 November source). §10: 'Since the condition is not asserted' -> 'Since the condition is a hypothesis of the results that take it, not an axiom'; the retired-labels table's current column 'stated and not asserted' -> 'a hypothesis where a result takes it'. §12: the orientation paragraph keeps E9 (which scope or order to hold is not derived; how scope and order form within the dynamics is in the target, items 3 and 12); 'Where the ethics turns' with E4/E5; item 12 (title, class and anchor kept) adds the self-concern route and 'how self-concern itself forms within the dynamics is open with them' (OPEN_LEAD's c-open quote kept word for word); the goal-records line and the philosophical question say the universal warrant is answered within the map, argued on the thesis of one relational unfolding, E6 said once there (no warrant binding every mind to find; `ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails`, `bounded_rival`; reach, the same gap alignment works on), ids and the anchor philosophical-warrant kept; 'Calling widening better ...' bullet -> 'C's order, P2 and P4 ...' (navigation's c-definition quote kept). Stated time of 'What a response takes in' was 'about 6 minutes'; counted by navigation.reading_time 6-8 minutes before and after, now stated so. Anchors: 92 before, 92 after, the same set.

items.item: (2) the edge sense: 08 §7 and 'What a response takes in', spine.json, the edge record, GLOSSARY
items.how: 08: 'has one standing against the edge of one root' -> 'is placed once against the edge of one root'; table head 'Standing against ...' -> 'Place against the edge of one root'; 'each central declaration has one standing against it' -> 'is placed once against it'; 'No standing in the last column' -> 'No place'; 'The two readings ... supply the scope-and-order row's input' -> the condition and C as hypotheses, self-concern supplying the order where the condition holds de se; that row's head likewise. The verb 'stand' kept ('The other 99 stand at a named distance', 'Neither stands on the edge'), so spine.json's 99 quote, its footer and connection_map's pinned note still hold. spine.json: caption[0] and standing.counts[0] (the 117 phrase spine.check reads), standing.en 'Places of the 117 ...', first_view.about, subtitle and footer[1] ('place', '08 §7's table of places'); data keys kept. one-root-to-its-edge.json (the record whose boundary field is 'standings'): statement en 'is placed once against the edge ... None is a premise: the condition for scope and C for order, hypotheses where used, are listed apart' (299 of 300), zh '于一根之边各居一位 ... 排序之果所取之二假设'; also its does-not-show line, which said 'That anyone must hold either reading ... and no warrant from outside is sought' (E6), now 'That the dynamics force either hypothesis the ranking results take: ...' with the same reason; a dated AG history entry added, earlier history untouched. GLOSSARY: the edge, derived and named-distance rows say 'place'; the how-far-seen row says the edge place was also called standing until 9 November 2026. correspondences.json's quotes listed below for the crosswalk phase.

02: '*Standing*:' on T1 and T2 -> '*How far seen*:'; 'Labels of standing and bases are 08's' -> 'Labels, which say how far each result has been seen, and bases are 08's'. The same line 14 ended 'where the ranking results take two readings as premises, neither used here: ... C for order (that widening is better)'; re-said in the same line: what they rank under taken as hypotheses, C as widening (keeping all another course keeps and letting more form) or, where the condition holds de se, self-concern, which there ranks every extension between listed level paths as C asks (read the brief's 'line' as line 14; revert that sentence if only the label was meant). No tool or record quotes these. 03 by sense: 'scientific standing' kept at lines 225, 475 and 570 and in the anchors scientific-standing and knowledge-and-standing (the scientific status of a practice or claim, ordinary English; correspondences.json paraphrases line 570); the six table heads 'Standing and statement' (they hold each result's label) -> 'Label and statement'; T6's '*Standing.*' -> '*How far seen.*'. Other 'standing' in 03 is persistence ('the stock then standing') and kept.

English: 'ranking, order (which course is better)' -> '(which course ranks above)', formed within becoming in people and AI, widening and narrowing more and less future, not good and evil, a result ranking only under its theorem's hypotheses (self-concern where the condition holds de se, else C or another named order); the continuation condition says 'has significance', scope, ranks nothing alone, «续无外» read on relations, where relations close (05) with the join not yet one theorem, E5's one-way limit; the own-closure row names «续无外»; a new row self-concern (`Weighting.IncreasingInOwn`), argued, a hypothesis derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence, with E4's link; C: 'widening: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form; C ranks such a course above the other', with `Comparison` and the free relation, not a second premise where the condition holds de se, elsewhere a named order; 生生: 'T8 states what the account's makers offer' -> 'T8: for life the ethics is offered as a way of seeing ...'. Kept phrases other files quote: lineage.json's living-significance, couples-into and shared-law quotes, spine.json's two derived-row quotes, PHILOSOPHY's significance quote. The glossary has no row for reading, scope or warrant, so none was added; the warrant is said once, in 08's philosophical question. Chinese: the same rows mirrored (排序、次序 header 哪一个进程排在上面; 延续条件 有意义, 续无外, 第五章, 第七章 §3.3; 自闭包读法; new 自我关切 row; C 扩大：保有另一进程所保有的一切，并让更多形成; 以广为愈 glossed without 更好, the name kept as 06's; 生生 'T8：本论的伦理为生命而提出'; 看到了多远 row notes the edge place was also called standing). zh_fronts.problems is empty.

for_ren: 08 §2 'Where the ethics sits', rewritten from your message 9: no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it; the ethics emerges from continuation; a life that goes on holds its own continuation (argued; in the proofs a hypothesis, self-concern, derived from no dynamics); the condition read on relations is 续无外 and holds where relations close; there holding one's own continuation already orders listed courses as widening does, so C is not a second premise there; where relations run one way T8's way of seeing reaches further, as seeing, not as a warrant.

08 §8: the review's verdict 'a clarified ethics, not a grounded one' kept as its words, with one line after it: within the map no ground beyond becoming is sought or needed, so the verdict records the review's measure, not a lack.

08 §12's philosophical question on a universal practical warrant, now 'answered within the map, argued': no should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find; that the dynamics and logic alone do not force the condition is proved; a narrower ranking is a matter of reach, the gap alignment works on.

The premise card's new row for self-concern, and the glossary's rows for the continuation condition, C ('widening: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form'), self-concern and ranking (widening and narrowing more and less future, not good and evil), English and Chinese.
A central declaration is now 'placed once against the edge of one root' (08 §7, the edge record, the glossary, the graph's captions); 'standing' is no longer used as a label there.
